intent: Hot fan-out of windows: start() subscribes buffer(source.events()) into Sinks.many().multicast().onBackpressureBuffer(capacity,false); tryEmitNext FAIL_OVERFLOW -> drop, broadcastDropped subscriber-overflow, step log broadcast-overflow-dropped; success -> windowBroadcast broadcast. subscribe() returns demand-driven Flux; subscriber disconnect never stops the sink. stop() disposes. observability.step_logs: ["window-broadcast", "broadcast-overflow-dropped"].

methods.signature: BroadcastService(ValidatedEventConsumer buffer, TelemetryEventSource source, TelemetryMetrics metrics, int sinkCapacity)
